title: RollMaze
description: Challenge your mind with Roll Maze, the addictive physics-based puzzle game that puts your spatial reasoning and timing skills to the ultimate test! Guide multiple balls through intricate mazes by rotating the entire playfield with precise mouse controls. Race against time to earn all three stars while our charming hero characters cheer you on from the background! Master increasingly complex levels Collect stars and achieve perfect scores Test your reflexes and strategic thinking Simple yet challenging mouse controls Endless gameplay with unlimited levels
instructions: Hold left on mouse and swipe left or right to turn maze
